literature.curated_finding: Primary study tested ponatinib in ER-positive breast cancer cells with dysregulated FGFR1 and included FGFR-driven breast models.
literature.limitations: Cell/model evidence only; not clinical efficacy or proof that the frozen LINCS condition engaged FGFR1.

literature.context: ERα-positive breast cancer cell models; PDGFR inhibitor and tamoxifen combination
literature.curated_finding: PubMed abstract reports that ponatinib (alongside sunitinib) inhibited growth and induced G0-G1 arrest in ERα-positive breast cancer cell models; adding either inhibitor to tamoxifen produced more consistent growth inhibition than tamoxifen alone.
literature.limitations: Abstract-level manual screen; exact cell-line identities and assay details require full-text review. Combination/preclinical result only; does not establish clinical efficacy or target engagement under the frozen LINCS condition.

literature_review_status: manual focused review records only; not systematic review
